name: Chicken, Strawberry & Avocado Salad with Spinach & Almonds

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) pkg strawberries
3 avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard the stem ends of the strawberries; cut the strawberries into quarters lengthwise and transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit the avocados, then scoop out the flesh and cut crosswise into slices; transfer to the plate with the strawberries.
Measure out the almonds into a small bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
Place the chicken on a cutting board and holding a knife parallel to the board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper, then rub with olive oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the chicken in the grill pan or skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minute per side. Once done, transfer to a cutting board.
While the chicken cooks, in a small bowl, combine olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper and whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice the chicken crosswise into bite-sized strips.
To serve, arrange a bed of the spinach on a plate and top with the avocado, strawberries, and chicken. Sprinkle with almonds and drizzle with the dressing just before serving. Enjoy!
